Same-prompt model comparison keeps earning saves: maxescu's 'Model selection is important. Exactly the same prompts' 18.3K / 66 bookmarks.
Cinema-grade claim + new model version: EHuanglu's 'AI video is now ready for cinema' (Seedance 2.5 4K documentary in 3 days) 16.5K / 110 bookmarks, best bookmark ratio among AI-video hits.
Off-niche but strong: minchoi's Claude Code '7 rules' thread 14.8K; azed_ai's platform-meta question 'Is X even worth our time anymore?' 12.5K / 185 likes (community debate bait).
Outsider search sample was weak (recent low-view posts only); no outsider cleared 5K.

drafts.draft_en:
Gladiator but it's 1974. 🏛️

Grainy film, zoom lenses, a sword-and-sandal epic from the Cinecittà era.

100% AI. Which film should I time-travel next?
drafts.video_tip: 12-15s faux 70s trailer: film grain, gate weave, soft halation, a hand-painted title card at the end. Original characters/costumes inspired by the era, no actor likenesses or official assets. Ask for the next film in the post to farm replies.

drafts.draft_en:
Same VFX prompt. 6 models.

Model choice changes everything: the fire, the debris, the camera.

Which one would you ship? 👇
drafts.video_tip: 2x3 grid of the same explosion/collapse shot, labeled small in a corner, synced to one beat; prompt in reply 1 so people bookmark.

drafts.draft_en:
AI VFX is ready for the big screen.

This shot would have taken a VFX team weeks.

I made it in an afternoon with Seedance 2.5 4K. Breakdown 👇
drafts.video_tip: 8s 4K hero shot full-frame, then a 6s breakdown: base plate -> prompt -> final. Only claim the times and tools you actually used.

drafts.draft_en:
Marseille but it's 1977. 🌊

Vieux-Port, a Peugeot chase, sunburnt film stock.

Made entirely with AI. Should I do Paris next?
drafts.video_tip: Local twist on the retro format: 10s of 4-5 shots (port, chase, rooftop, title card) with a 70s Euro-crime color grade; your home city is an angle nobody else on the watchlist has.

drafts.draft_en:
Hot take: the best AI VFX right now isn't on X.

It's buried in Discord servers and DMs.

Where do you actually share your best work? 👇
drafts.video_tip: Open with a 5s reel of your best Saturday Challenge entries, then text card with the question; ties the platform debate to your community series.
